description: This file defines an abstract class 'RuleChainManagerActor' responsible for managing rule chains within the Thingsboard server, including initialization, destruction, actor creation, and message broadcasting related to rule chains.

classes.name: RuleChainManagerActor
classes.description: An abstract actor class managing rule chains, including initialization, destruction, actor creation, and message broadcasting within the Thingsboard server.

methods.name: initRuleChains
methods.description: Initializes rule chains by creating actors for each tenant rule chain of type CORE.

methods.name: destroyRuleChains
methods.description: Destroys all rule chain actors for the tenant.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Sets the root rule chain and its actor if the given rule chain is a root of type CORE.

methods.name: getOrCreateActor
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an actor for a given rule chain ID, with optional provider function.

methods.name: getEntityActorRef
methods.description: Returns the actor reference for a given entity ID if it is a rule chain.

methods.name: broadcast
methods.description: Broadcasts a message to all child actors of type RULE_CHAIN.
